hostiles.finding: The proposed witness can faithfully hash Q(F_P1), predicate(P2), and the P2 AST without proving F_P1 denotes P1 or equals the predicate leaf/value. Exact co-custody is not an exact semantic relation.
hostiles.smallest_fix: Freeze a per-binding value-bearing relation/preimage and verify it against the exact producer predicate leaf/value before slice construction.

hostiles.attack: Reuse a P1-derived slice under a P2 consumer query with the same retained conditioner IDs.
hostiles.finding: Binding to consumer_query.ref plus a validated full binding relation can reject cross-query reuse before the consumer. As currently written, the guard is directionally correct but inherits H01's missing value proof.

hostiles.attack: Two facts have equal counts/ratio but different exact denominator_member_refs.
hostiles.finding: I03 producer fact/replay identity carries denominator_member_refs and the C1 envelope explicitly retains them; they cannot lawfully alias.

hostiles.attack: RAW and GOVERNED_WEIGHTED produce numerically equal proportions.
hostiles.finding: Worker freezes measure_kind, measure_basis_ref, weight_basis_id and used WeightMeasureFact design/estimand context. Equal visible ratio is not identity.

hostiles.attack: Reuse evidence when the target ref is unchanged but topology/domain/replay material changes.
hostiles.finding: Producer query identity and target_domain_identity change; C1 requires full topology/domain/replay material and refuses non-scalar scalarization at C1-01.
Worker preserves SUPPORTED observed-zero cell, ZERO_SUPPORT/ZERO_OVERLAP, and VALID_EMPTY separately. I03 complete-cell state and outer analytical state make the distinction representable.

hostiles.attack: Represent a lifecycle state whose currentness is unknown and an adaptive unit that is merely unvisited.
hostiles.finding: The return freezes EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN_UNVISITED and UNRESOLVED but not a distinct UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN_CURRENTNESS case. Existing B5 exposes UNKNOWN_CURRENTNESS separately, so the omission is not forced by current owners.
hostiles.smallest_fix: Add UNKNOWN_CURRENTNESS (or another exact owner-native UNKNOWN path) to the state matrix and output state vocabulary, independently from adaptive unvisited and unresolved.

hostiles.attack: Treat a partial/exhausted exploratory frontier as global negative evidence.
hostiles.finding: Adaptive checkpoint retains exact unvisited_unit_refs and forbids global_negative_claim. Worker correctly refuses fabricated PossibilitySliceEvidence for unvisited territory.

hostiles.attack: Two child predicates look alike but descend from different immediate parent refs.
hostiles.finding: RecursiveBranchHandoff validates exact parent_branch_ref in its replay binding; worker retains handoff plus full discovery record.
Worker explicitly separates bounded consumer replay from I03, discovery, recursive, adaptive and full composition fresh-process recomputation.

hostiles.attack: Bypass M1/M2/B5/I4 after a learned/adjudicated claim fails by calling it DIRECT_PRODUCER.
hostiles.finding: Family binding manifest explicitly forbids this and also forbids universal learned wrapping of competent direct output. Concrete family exercises remain later mandatory work.

hostiles.attack: Implementation A sets PossibilitySliceEvidence.raw_support=denominator and geometry contains exact cell counts/rates; implementation B sets raw_support=resolved-target support and uses another exact geometry mapping. Current consumer accepts either.
hostiles.finding: Worker prose requires exact complete-cell geometry but does not freeze a canonical geometry schema or raw_support meaning. The consumer class validates only Mapping + nonnegative integer.
hostiles.smallest_fix: Freeze one canonical C1-01 evidence projection and raw_support meaning before implementation.

hostiles.attack: Reuse the same synthetic authority tag but change governed operation/scope/material in C1-01.
hostiles.finding: fixture_oracle_manifest freezes tags, not full authority material or expected hashes; the future implementation can alter authority semantics without violating the manifest text.
hostiles.smallest_fix: Freeze complete test-only authority material and exact expected refs/hashes now.

hostiles.attack: Change the relation witness while query/predicate/binding fingerprint remain otherwise fixed.
hostiles.finding: Analytical output carries condition_binding_witness_ref_or_hash, but replay_and_dependency_receipt.direct_determinants omits it.
hostiles.smallest_fix: Make witness/relation ref a mandatory composition determinant and selective-invalidation input.

core_counterexample.name: RIGHT_IDENTITIES_WRONG_RELATION
construction: Create consumer query Q1 whose ConditionerBinding has binding_id=position and subject_fact_ref=F_P1.
Use exact producer query/predicate P2 selecting POSITION == P2 with the same U/R/target/risk/measure.
Construct the proposed ConditionValueBindingWitness with Q1.ref, Q1 full binding fingerprint, P2 query ref, P2 predicate ref/hash and canonical P2 AST.
All fields can be recomputed exactly from supplied objects, yet no frozen rule resolves F_P1 to P1 or rejects its pairing with P2.
core_counterexample.consequence: The adapter can manufacture an exact but false condition/value bridge without violating the frozen contract.
core_counterexample.reason: At the synthetic source-free C1-01 grain, the packet can be repaired by freezing value-bearing fixture preimages/relations and exact adapter checks. Real-source comparability remains separately blocked rather than invented.
